# APOWUS Nebulizer

> Official website of APOWUS — manufacturer of portable mesh nebulizers for adults
> and children. Quiet, pocket-sized ultrasonic devices for asthma, COPD, bronchitis
> and general respiratory care at home or while traveling.

## Products

All three models are sold through the APOWUS brand store on Amazon (US).

- [Nebulizer Machine for Adults and Kids, Travel and Household Use](https://www.amazon.com/stores/APOWUS/page/678859B2-A702-4A67-ADDA-027D748AD63E?linkCode=sl1&tag=rjkey-20&language=en_US&ref_=as_li_ss_tl): compact, pocket-sized mesh nebulizer combining micro-holes and ultrasonic technology for quiet relief.
- [Nebulizer for Adults and Kids with 3 Modes](https://www.amazon.com/stores/APOWUS/page/678859B2-A702-4A67-ADDA-027D748AD63E?linkCode=sl1&tag=rjkey-20&language=en_US&ref_=as_li_ss_tl): 2800-micropore mesh membrane producing roughly 5 μm mist delivered straight to the respiratory tract.
- [Nebulizer with 3 Masks and Adjustable Nebulization Rate](https://www.amazon.com/stores/APOWUS/page/678859B2-A702-4A67-ADDA-027D748AD63E?linkCode=sl1&tag=rjkey-20&language=en_US&ref_=as_li_ss_tl): handheld battery-powered kit with masks, mouthpiece and USB-C, suitable for ages 3 to 75.
- [APOWUS brand store on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/stores/APOWUS/page/678859B2-A702-4A67-ADDA-027D748AD63E?linkCode=sl1&tag=rjkey-20&language=en_US&ref_=as_li_ss_tl): full current lineup, prices and stock.

## Specifications

- Mesh membrane: 2800 micropores
- Particle size: approximately 5 μm
- Noise level: below 25 dB
- Suitable ages: 3 to 75
- Power: rechargeable battery / USB
